commit.message:
🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source
selection to verify measurement and publication on Ubicloud.
